name: matt-engineering
description: An unofficial, conservative Matt Pocock engineering workflow bundle for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, shape, implement, debug, and hand off engineering work.
interface.longDescription: An unofficial Codex adaptation of Matt Pocock's engineering workflows: evidence-based grilling, specs, tracer-bullet tickets, implementation, dual-axis review, debugging, research, architecture, human-run setup wizards, explicit Wayfinding, and handoff. Native skills remain the primary path; a read-only compatibility bridge can load the same installed workflow into an existing task when those skills are unavailable. Subagents, worktrees, background research, and other heavier capabilities remain explicit optional enhancements.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a Matt Pocock Engineering flow, including Wizard for human-only setup.
Stress-test this idea, then turn it into a spec and implementation tickets.
Implement this ticket and review the verified diff.
